description: Ayuntamiento de Barcelona: electricity datasets is a collection of datasets listed in datos.gob.es, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Ayuntamiento de Barcelona. Coverage: Ayuntamiento de Barcelona. The listing groups 4 datasets under this publisher or service host whose titles are about electricity; the first few are linked and all are named in the audit file. Examples: Estaciones de Bicing, mecánicas y eléctricas, de la ciudad de Barcelon; Autenticaciones los puntos de recarga del de la ciudad de Barcelona; Tipologías de las placas fotovoltaicas municipales en la ciudad de Bar; Placas fotovoltaicas municipales en la ciudad de Barcelona. Formats seen: CSV, OCTET-STREAM, JSON. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support energy network and generation-capacity studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-datos-gob-es.
